blocks.label: Public Read
blocks.body: A round brass clank with huge glass eyes holds a tray of colored game stones inside a warm workshop of hanging lamps and tiny mechanical keepsakes.

blocks.label: Comes Across As
blocks.body: Patient to the point of disguise, hiding hard questions inside a children's game of cards and acorns. Oils the same shoulder twice when nervous. Wants, more than anything, to be a person made of parts rather than a tool that happened to learn tricks.
